title: On Utility Maximization under Multivariate Fake Stationary Affine Volterra Models
summary: This paper is concerned with Merton's portfolio optimization problem in a Volterra stochastic environment described by a multivariate fake stationary Volterra--Heston model. Due to the non-Markovianity and non-semimartingality of the underlying processes, the classical stochastic control approach cannot be directly applied in this setting. Instead, the problem is tackled using a stochastic factor solution to a Riccati backward stochastic differential equation (BSDE).
